items.name: langchain-ai/langchain langchain==1.4.0a2
items.description:
Alpha preview of `langchain.mcp` — a first-party adapter that turns any MCP server into LangChain tools you can hand straight to `create_agent`.

Connection handling is [FastMCP](https://gofastmcp.com/clients/client)'s, so its client features are available as-is rather than re-implemented behind a narrower interface.

```bash
pip install "langchain[mcp]==1.4.0a2"
```

**Agent: E2B Sandbox, Home Snapshots, and Skill Management**
- **E2B sandbox backend**: agent shell/code execution can now run on [E2B](https://e2b.dev) cloud sandboxes in addition to the local sandbox. * Ollama's app now follows the system appearance again, restoring dark mode support
* Fixed the macOS app to properly hand off to an already-running instance instead of starting a second one
* The Claude Desktop proxy no longer interrupts in-flight requests when the model catalog updates
